body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Friday, August 14, 2026, and we’re starting the day with a look at a serious incident that unfolded overnight: police are searching for a red pickup after a woman was reportedly seen crying for help near Chester and Belle Terrace. Today’s high will hit 95°, and we’re looking at moderate air quality. Let’s get you caught up on the night, the news, and the week ahead.

## The Kern Overnight

The night opened with a tense road-rage incident on East White Lane around 9:23 p.m., where a blue Honda with paper plates and a white pickup were repeatedly stopping and blocking the roadway eastbound. City units were dispatched to the scene, though no further updates were heard on the air. Later, around 10:33 p.m., a white 2001 Dodge van with California plates was reported stolen on Kentucky Street; officers took the report, and no arrests were announced on the air. The night’s most serious call came around 11:34 p.m., when Bakersfield police broadcast an attempt-to-locate and welfare check after a caller described an older-model red truck at South Chester Avenue and Belle Terrace — a male hanging out the driver’s window, a female crying and saying she needed help. The truck was last seen traveling southbound, and the broadcast went out citywide for any unit to catch the truck. No further update was heard on the air before the feed moved on. Around the same time, CHP broadcast a 23152 on southbound I-5 south of the Grapevine — a newer black pickup at speeds over 90, passing on the shoulder, the driver seen drinking from an open container. Units were responding as the feed moved on. Fire crews were comparatively quiet: a residential alarm that amounted to nothing and a vehicle accident that drew an engine, battalion and rescue unit before the air went quiet. Shortly before 3 a.m., a traffic collision in the Flying J truck stop parking lot at Frazier Park drew CHP to investigate a hit-and-run claim after a burgundy Freightliner was hit by a red Peterbilt, with the other party denying involvement.

## Today's weather

Today’s high will reach near 95°, with a low around 67° tonight. It’s currently 84° at Meadows Field (KBFL). No active weather alerts are in effect for Kern County, and air quality is moderate at an AQI of 54. Enjoy the sunshine, but stay cool as we head into the weekend.

## Top stories

**KGET 17 reports that** Bakersfield Christian High School’s football team is looking to bounce back after a tough state title loss last season. The Eagles are working hard in training camp to address the issues that cost them the championship game, and coaches say the team is focused on improving fundamentals and building a stronger defense. **According to 23ABC,** Bakersfield police and fire chiefs shared their Fourth of July findings at a recent meeting, revealing that while fire-related responses dropped 6% compared to 2025, more work remains to curb fireworks-related incidents in the city. **KGET 17 also told us that** Kern County homeless recovery leader Carlos Baldovinos helped shape a new federal best practices toolkit aimed at addressing addiction treatment within the homeless community. Baldovinos, executive director of the Mission at Kern County, was among roughly 22 professionals from across the country who worked with federal agencies to develop the toolkit, which outlines best practices for working with individuals dealing with addiction within the homeless population. **23ABC said that** Kern County supervisors are exploring a proposal that would place Kern and dozens of other counties in a new state, separate from coastal California. Kern County District 3 Supervisor Jeff Flores said the effort is about making sure the region’s industries and way of life are taken seriously by state leaders. **KGET 17 announced that** Kern County officials will inform the public on local ICE activity during a community forum on August 25. The forum will provide an opportunity for residents to learn more about immigration enforcement in the area and ask questions of local officials.

## Something good

Bakersfield and Tehachapi airports will receive a portion of $109 million in federal aviation funding. This investment will support local airport infrastructure and operations, ensuring our community’s airports remain safe and efficient for years to come.

## Coming up this week

Looking ahead, the Multi Modal Transportation And Traffic Safety Committee will meet on Wednesday, August 18, at 12:00 p.m. The Planning Commission will convene on Thursday, August 20, at 5:30 p.m. The Historic Preservation Commission is set to meet on Tuesday, August 18, at 4:00 p.m. The Water Board will hold a meeting on Wednesday, August 19, at 10:00 a.m. The Miscellaneous Civil Service Commission will meet on Tuesday, August 18, at 2:00 p.m. On the events front, PEPPER With CYDEWAYS will perform at the Fox Theater tonight, August 14. Los Yonic's Zamacona, Los caminantes, y Grupo Yndio will take the stage at the Fox Theater on August 22. Comedian Rodney Carrington will perform at the Fox Theater on August 27. CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE will light up the Fox Theater on August 28. Willie Barcena will bring laughs to the Fox Theater on August 29. And Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix will perform at the Fox Theater on August 29. Be sure to mark your calendars for these upcoming events and meetings.
